page: Microsoft Azure E2as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EASv4 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. The configuration includes 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. Cache resources consist of 32 KB L1d, 0.5 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is limited to a 33 GB volume, though the instance is Premium Storage capable. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPUs are included.

Benchmark data reveals a stark contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is strong, placing in the top 25 percent with a score of 2703.88. However, multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng falls into the bottom 25 percent at the same score, reflecting the physical limitations of a single-core, two-thread layout. Memory bandwidth is relatively constrained, with cached small-block read-only bandwidth ranking in the bottom 10 percent at 127.94 GB/sec, and uncached large-block read and write bandwidths falling into the bottom 25 percent at 32.67 GB/sec and 22.32 GB/sec respectively. Geekbench multi-core, software compilation, and ray tracing benchmarks all rank in the bottom 10 percent, highlighting the server's limitations for highly parallelized or compute-intensive workloads.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the E2as_v4 is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint without demanding heavy parallel processing power. It achieves average performance in single-threaded gzip compression, bzip3 decompression, and text processing. However, it performs poorly in database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations, all ranking in the bottom 10 percent. Consequently, this instance is best suited for lightweight memory-bound applications, basic text processing, simple single-threaded tasks, or development environments rather than high-throughput databases or intensive web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure E2as_v4 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the EASv4 family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz. It features 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core, 16.0 GB of RAM, and 33 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. While its single-core CPU performance is strong, ranking in the top 25 percent in stress-ng benchmarks, its multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities are weak, often falling into the bottom 10 percent to 25 percent. This resource profile makes the E2as_v4 qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-heavy but compute-light applications. It is best suited for lightweight memory-bound workloads, single-threaded processing, and development environments, rather than high-throughput database operations or parallelized computing tasks.
